o.norm: a bit of a back door in!
same as stream, just a different interface
checks expected order, and the + indicates that element had a next sibling at time of emission

i.norm:
Appends a concise representation of {@code el} to {@code actual}.

Format per element: {@code tagName[#id][ownText][+];}

  • {@code #id} – present when the element has an {@code id} attribute
  • {@code [text]} – present when the element has non-empty own (direct) text
  • {@code +} – present when the element had a next sibling at emission time

iterator() is the same interface as stream(), just pull-based. Elements are emitted depth-first (children before parents); "+" means the element had a next sibling at the moment it was emitted by the parser.
